'''Kersh Lauskner's Traveling Animal/Acrobatic Arcadium''' was a traveling entertainer troupe run by [[Kersh Lauskner]]. It was present during the [[Gralleenya Gala]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Questal/Legends|Questal]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
